req.title: Retrieve player by ID
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/{playerId} with the corresponding player object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /players/{playerId} returning HTTP 200 with a matching Player object. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid UUID returns 200 + exact player fields; (2) negative NEG — non-existent UUID returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — malformed/non-UUID path segment returns 422 (FastAPI path validation); (4) boundary BVA — first seeded player (squad 1, lowest UUID boundary); (5) boundary BVA — last seeded player (squad 26, highest UUID boundary); (6) negative NEG — nil UUID (all-zeros) not in DB returns 404. Each test asserts exact status codes and exact field values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_valid_uuid_returns_200_and_exact_fields
expected: Response body matches all fields of the seeded player exactly
trace: R-PLAYER-002: system shall respond with matching Player object on valid UUID
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_id_valid_uuid_returns_200_and_exact_fields():
    player_id = '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    r = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == player_id
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['middleName'] == ''
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'GK'
    assert body['team'] == 'Manchester City'
    assert body['league'] == 'Serie A'
    assert body['starting11'] == False
